name: fin

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/state && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.real:migrate: mkdir -p $HOME/.finance/local && chmod 700 $HOME/.finance $HOME/.finance/local && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc --persist-to $HOME/.finance/local
scripts.real: npm run real:build && npm run real:migrate && wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc --port 5190 --ip 127.0.0.1 --persist-to $HOME/.finance/local --assets build-real/client
scripts.deploy: rm -rf dist && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=${CLOUDFLARE_ENV:-production} vite build && wrangler deploy
scripts.cloud:backup: mkdir -p $HOME/.finance/backups && wrangler d1 export DB --remote --env ${CLOUDFLARE_ENV:-production} --config ${WRANGLER_CONFIG:-wrangler.jsonc} --output $HOME/.finance/backups/cloud-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).sql && chmod 600 $HOME/.finance/backups/cloud-*.sql

description: Give your agent a surface to manage your finances: a double-entry ledger, CLI and read-only web app on Cloudflare.
